Core's `HyperAmplification.cs` adapts the typed-edge subdivision and procedural
terrain/profile ideas from the Arches-Team implementation of Cortial et al.,
*Real-Time Hyper-Amplification of Planets* (2020).

Source: https://github.com/Arches-Team/Real-Time-Hyper-Amplification-of-Planets

Inspected commit: `b3341c336b2b3070def911fd0c5df196de2bfc64`.

The MIT license supplied with that revision is reproduced in `LICENSE`.
This integration is a modified CPU evaluator for WorldGen, not the authors'
standalone application, shader pipeline, original parameters or benchmark.
